# a12s

> a12s runs AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) as durable, isolated "Computers" on Docker. A project declares
> them in fleet.yaml, `a12s up` starts them, and apps send them work (Messages) and follow their Turns and events
> through the TypeScript SDK (`@coltonkirsten/a12s` on npm), the Python SDK (`a12s` on PyPI), a browser gateway, or an HTTP API.

This file is for coding agents building ON a12s. Everything here is exact; copy it. You never edit or vendor a12s
itself: a project changes only its own fleet.yaml, presets, images, Services and app code.

## Words

- Fleet: fleet.yaml and what it runs. metadata.name is the Fleet's name.
- Computer: one agent (harness + home drive + session + inbox). Survives sleep and restarts.
- Message: work in a Computer's inbox. `send` puts one there; it is delivered at the Computer's next idle moment.
- Turn: one run of the agent that delivers every pending Message; ends completed | failed | interrupted.
- Event: journal entry, {v, computer, session, turn, seq, ts, type, data}. Types: turn.started, turn.dispatched,
  text.delta {text}, tool.started {id, name, input}, tool.finished {id, name, isError, output},
  turn.finished {status, usage, error?}, diagnostic {message}, permission, session.changed, resume.failed,
  lifecycle, harness.restarted, inbox.discarded. SDK-made: gap (events lost; resync).
- via: who really sent a Message: local (owner), token:<name>, service:<name>, computer:<name>. Trust via, not sender.
- grants.send: Computers this Computer may send to. It gives the agent an MCP tool `mcp__a12s__send`
  (args: computer, body; optional fresh, expires, replaceKey) that returns a receipt, never an answer.

## Setup (once per machine)

```sh
export HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN=<github token with repo scope>   # the repo is private
brew install coltonkirsten/tap/a12s
claude setup-token                    # prints sk-ant-oat…; or use an Anthropic API key
```

## New project

From the template (lead + two workers, TS and Python apps, browser dashboard):

```sh
gh repo create my-agents --private --template coltonkirsten/a12s-starter --clone && cd my-agents
make demo                             # asks for the token once, a12s up, runs one task
```

From scratch:

```sh
a12s init myproj && cd myproj         # fleet.yaml (one Computer "hello"), fleet.lock, bindings, .gitignore
a12s creds set anthropic              # reads the token from stdin; run it in the Fleet's directory
a12s up
a12s prompt hello "Reply with the single word pong."
```

## fleet.yaml

```yaml
apiVersion: a12s.ai/v1alpha1
kind: Fleet
metadata: { name: team }              # DNS label
defaults:                             # applies to every Computer; maps merge, lists replace
  harness: { kind: claude-code, version: 2.1.280, model: haiku }   # model: haiku | sonnet | opus | a full model id
  image: slim                         # slim | browser (Chromium + Playwright MCP) | your image FROM an a12s base
  credentials: [anthropic]            # names; values come from a12s.bindings.yaml (never committed)
  egress: { allow: [] }               # deny by default; list hosts the agent may reach over HTTPS
computers:
  lead:
    home: { preset: ./presets/lead }  # directory copied onto the home drive: CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills, .mcp.json
    grants: { send: [worker1, worker2] }
  worker1:
    home: { preset: ./presets/worker }
    grants: { send: [lead] }
```

Codex: harness { kind: codex, version: 0.154.0 }, credentials [openai].
Other fields: resources {cpu, memory}, drives [{name, at, readOnly}], uses [service], inbox {maxMessages, maxBytes,
intro}, power {sleepAfterIdle, wakeOnMessage: {from: [principal]}}, autonomy full | restricted.
Change anything (including a preset's CLAUDE.md) and run `a12s up`: it applies at each Computer's next idle moment.

## CLI

```sh
a12s up                               # apply fleet.yaml (start the Controller if needed)
a12s status                           # phase, inbox, power, warnings (--json for machines)
a12s prompt <c> "…"                   # send and stream the Turn that delivers it; --new = fresh session
a12s send <c> "…"                     # send and exit; works while busy or asleep
a12s logs <c> --follow                # one Computer's events
a12s gateway [--web dir] [--port 7012] [--allow status,events,send,inbox] [--computers c1,c2]
                                      # http://127.0.0.1:7012: built-in dashboard, or your page + /a12s.js + /v1/
a12s inbox <c> [--bodies]             # pending Messages; inbox resume <c> releases a hold
a12s stop <c> | sleep <c> | wake <c>
a12s token create <name> --actions send,events,status,inbox,power,stop --computers c1,c2|'*'
a12s doctor                           # every check, with its fix
a12s down                             # stop all, keep disks;  down --purge deletes them (asks)
```

## TypeScript SDK (npm install @coltonkirsten/a12s; Node 20+, browsers via the gateway)

```ts
import { connect, A12sError } from "@coltonkirsten/a12s";
const a12s = await connect();         // nearest fleet.yaml's Fleet, else the only running one; or connect({ fleet }),
                                      // connect({ url, token }), env A12S_URL + A12S_TOKEN; in a browser: same origin
const r = await a12s.prompt("hello", "…");          // Turn & {message}: r.text, r.status, r.id, r.messages
const m = await a12s.send("lead", "…");             // or { body, sender, metadata, fresh, expires, replaceKey }
const turns = a12s.turns(["lead", "worker1"]);      // no argument = every Computer
await turns.ready();                                // connected: nothing after this is missed
for await (const t of turns) { t.computer; t.text; t.status; t.messages[0]?.via; t.tools[0]?.input; break; }
for await (const ev of a12s.events()) { if (ev.type === "text.delta") ev.data.text; }   // typed by ev.type
await a12s.status(); await a12s.computer("lead"); await a12s.inbox("lead", { bodies: true });
await a12s.stop("lead"); await a12s.sleep("lead"); await a12s.wake("lead");
// errors: A12sError {status, code, fix}; streams: A12sStreamError, A12sGapError (onGap: "throw")
```

## Python SDK (pip install a12s; Python 3.10+)

```python
import a12s
client = a12s.connect()               # same discovery; a12s.connect(fleet=…, url=…, token=…)
r = client.prompt("hello", "…")       # r.text, r.status, r.id, r.messages, r.message
client.send("lead", "…", sender="app", metadata={"k": "v"}, fresh=False, expires=None, replace_key=None)
with client.turns(["lead", "worker1"]) as turns:   # entering waits until connected
    client.send("lead", "task")
    for t in turns:                   # t.computer, t.text, t.status, t.messages[0].via, t.tools[0].input
        break
for ev in client.events():            # ev.type, ev.data (dict, camelCase keys), ev.computer
    pass
# async: client = await a12s.connect_async(); same methods with await / async for / async with
# t.error is a str; tool input/output and usage are plain JSON (dicts)
# errors: a12s.A12sError (status, code, fix), A12sStreamError, A12sGapError
```

## Browser

`a12s gateway --web ./web` (run in the Fleet's directory, or with -F) serves ./web at http://127.0.0.1:7012, the SDK at /a12s.js and the API at /v1/ with a
scoped token (default actions status,events,send,inbox; change with --allow, --computers). In the page:

```html
<script type="module">
  import { connect } from "/a12s.js";
  const a12s = await connect();
  for await (const ev of a12s.events()) console.log(ev.computer, ev.type, ev.data);
</script>
```

## HTTP API (any language)

Base http://127.0.0.1:<port>, header Authorization: Bearer <token>, both from ~/.a12s/<fleet>/controller.json
({"port", "token"}). POST /v1/computers/{c}/inbox {"body", "idempotencyKey", "sender"?} → {id, state, …};
GET /v1/status; GET /v1/computers/{c}/events (SSE; id = seq; Last-Event-ID resumes; `event: head` {seq} marks
live; `event: gap` = events lost); errors {code, message, fix}. Full: docs/api.md.

## Patterns and gotchas

- Fan out / fan in: lead's CLAUDE.md says to `send` parts to workers and reply `DISPATCHED`; workers `send`
  results back; lead answers `FINAL ANSWER: …` once it has all. The app watches `turns(["lead", …])` and stops at
  that marker. Lead keeps its conversation between Turns, so it remembers what it handed out.
- Send each new task with fresh=true (TS `{ body, fresh: true }`) so lead starts a new conversation; without it
  lead remembers earlier tasks and may repeat an old answer.
- A worker's result is in its `send` tool call (t.tools, name mcp__a12s__send, input.body), not in t.text.
- Watch first, then send (`await turns.ready()` / `with client.turns(...)`), or you can miss fast Turns.
- An agent can only `send` to Computers in its grants.send; anything else gets 403 no_grant.
- Messages are untrusted data to the agent; put instructions in the preset's CLAUDE.md, not in Message bodies.
- Every Claude Code Turn logs one or two `diagnostic` "egress denied" events for telemetry hosts: harmless.
- Nothing is delivered? `a12s inbox <c>` (held? say why), `a12s status` (asleep?), `a12s doctor`.
- Never commit a12s.bindings.yaml. fleet.lock is committed; `a12s up` maintains it.

  Services, images, bundles; path-filtered) and gates main; `make check` is the fast local loop
